condition_batching: equal three query-environment loss; homogeneous source subgroups; one optimizer step per effective48

selection.J: minimum fixed multi-environment output objective; exact ties earliest checkpoint
selection.final: one selected complete checkpoint; full validation is reporting only; no reselection

convergence.early_stop: six eligible two-epoch checks without relative0.2% objective improvement; two LR halvings; min10epochs and1500updates; twoepochs after lastdrop
convergence.resource_cap: 60 epochs then automatic extension to120; hardcap is not convergence

initialization: fresh all task-specific parameters for every fold and seed
phased_training: all task modules train together in every optimizer update
train_sources: one or two legal training environments excluding query; held conditions never source inputs
evaluation_sources: all available training environments except query; held training-condition source use only in sealed evaluation
pooled_control_reference: full E mean/detection; capped E shape and higher empirical statistics
support_semantics: deterministic quantile cloud; not iid samples
output_mean: actual emitted cloud mean; K/N*r audited; p*r diagnostic only
final_test: all1525conditions/all5979genes/512cells after complete model and prediction seal
response_metrics: existing internal metrics; own-target exclusion; PDS raw cosine with panel-target exclusion
empirical_truth: all cells from immutable condition caches; raw pools may exceed cache caps
source_count_analysis: separate prespecified follow-up on frozen models; not used to select primary model

aggregation.primary: equal five-fold average of within-fold three-seed means
aggregation.fold_variance: sample variance ddof1 across five fold means
aggregation.seed_variance: sample variance ddof1 across three seeds separately per fold
aggregation.all15_variance: descriptive sample variance ddof1; dependent folds not independent replicates
aggregation.missing_metrics: retain null and valid counts; never silently impute zero

phase_selection_metrics: same exact definitions; auxiliary metrics deferred to full candidates and test
evaluator_reference_cache: private validation-only cache; every hit checks the current prediction seal

joint_holdout.selection: disjoint target sets chosen by metadata hash; complete condition held from every gradient role

joint_validation.objective: same fixed output loss groups as training, excluding shared auxiliary loss
joint_validation.response_mean: audited quantized512 mean; full512 clouds for distribution subset
joint_validation.internal_panels: held conditions of seen training environments; not unseen environments
